significance: Completed in 1600 by Gopal Singh of Karauli on the bank of the Bhadravati in the Aravalli hills, to house a Madan Mohan image brought from Vrindavan for safety. It is counted among the four dhams of Karauli district and is treated as a required halt on the Govardhan Yatra.
story: Gopal Singh is said to have been told by the deity in a dream to fetch his Madan Mohan image from Vrindavan to Rajasthan before Aurangzeb's attacks on temples.
